tokens.name: mist
tokens.usage: Page ground (the deck's cool mist). Under ink, ink-muted and sky-deep text in both themes.

tokens.name: mist-deep
tokens.usage: Recessed ground: pressed rows, the unselected half of the segmented control, skeletons.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Solid cards, inputs, bottom sheets, the white circle icon button. Ink and ink-muted read on it in both themes.

tokens.name: glass
tokens.usage: Frosted panel fill over haze or mist. Always pair with glass-edge and the glass-blur backdrop filter. Ink reads 8:1 on it over mist.

tokens.name: glass-edge
tokens.usage: The 1px rim on every glass panel, pill and card. Decorative, never the only boundary of a control.

tokens.name: glass-on-sky
tokens.usage: Glass fill for the nav pill and glass button on the sky backdrop. Over atmos-deep, white labels hold 5:1.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Headlines and body text (the deck's charcoal in Mist). On mist, mist-deep, surface, glass and sky-soft. On a sky fill, use on-sky.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text, metadata, timestamps, placeholders. On mist, surface and glass (min 4.9:1 in both themes).

tokens.name: charcoal
tokens.usage: Always-dark feature slabs (the deck's dark panels) in either theme: charcoal ContentCards, pitch panels, charcoal avatars. Same value in both themes; for actions use inverse.

tokens.name: on-charcoal
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a charcoal fill (9.3:1).

tokens.name: inverse
tokens.usage: The strongest fill in a theme: primary buttons, the FAB, active tab, active menu row, current timeline step. Charcoal in Mist, near-white in Charcoal so it never disappears into a #424242 card.

tokens.name: on-inverse
tokens.usage: Text and icons on an inverse fill (9.3:1 light, 14:1 dark).

tokens.name: sky
tokens.usage: Brand blue. Highlighted cards, selected ride, active timeline step, the Networking tag, big-number bubbles. Text on it is on-sky.

tokens.name: sky-soft
tokens.usage: Pale sky wash behind sky-deep text; hover on glass rows.

tokens.name: sky-glow
tokens.usage: The pale end of the sky gradient on highlighted cards and ride slots (sky to sky-glow). Light in both themes so on-sky text stays readable across the whole gradient.

tokens.name: sky-deep
tokens.usage: Blue as text, links, icons and the focus ring. On mist (4.7:1), surface and sky-soft.

tokens.name: on-sky
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a sky fill (8.9:1).

tokens.name: atmos
tokens.usage: The sky backdrop from the nav reference: splash, onboarding and marketing heroes. White text on it is only 2.8:1, so never put body text straight on atmos.

tokens.name: atmos-deep
tokens.usage: Deep sky behind the glass nav and glass buttons; white on it is 7.4:1, and 5:1 through glass-on-sky. Also the FlyPal tag and deep-blue avatars, with on-atmos text.

tokens.name: on-atmos
tokens.usage: Labels on atmos-deep (FlyPal tags, deep avatars) and on glass-on-sky over atmos-deep.

tokens.name: flare
tokens.usage: Cherry red, on the FlyTag plane only: tail fin, stabilisers and fuselage stripe. Not for UI, text or status; errors stay danger.

tokens.name: flare-deep
tokens.usage: Shaded side of flare surfaces on the plane (trailing edge of the tail, far stabiliser).

tokens.name: plane-shade
tokens.usage: Shaded underside of the plane's white body. Plane only.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Decorative hairlines: header rule, menu dividers, column rules in feature panels.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Borders that define a control: outline buttons, empty inputs, ride-slot outline. 3:1 on mist and surface.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Focus ring: 2px solid, 2px offset. Alias of sky-deep, so it holds 3:1 on every ground.

tokens.name: go
tokens.usage: Success: seat confirmed, ride full. Always with a word or check icon. On mist and surface.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Errors and leave-ride. Always with a word. On mist (4.5:1) and surface.

families.sans: "Open Sauce One", "Open Sauce Sans", "Helvetica Neue", Arial, sans-serif

styles.name: display
styles.usage: Wordmark and hero statements, ending in a full stop like the deck's "Startup." One per screen.

styles.name: numeral
styles.usage: Big figures inside stat bubbles and pitch slides.

styles.name: title-xl
styles.usage: Screen titles in the app header ("UCSD", "Profile") and section heads on slides.

styles.name: heading
styles.usage: Ride slot times, card titles, rider names in detail views.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Uppercase eyebrow labels (the deck's PROBLEM 1). Always uppercase, never a sentence.

styles.name: body-lg
styles.usage: Lead paragraphs, nav labels, button labels at lg.
styles.sample: Tag along with fellow classmates to and from the airport.

styles.name: body
styles.usage: Default body, inputs, chat messages. Never smaller on mobile.
styles.sample: Hey, let's meet at the Sixth market since it's pretty central.

styles.name: body-sm
styles.usage: Secondary lines: college, seat counts, helper text.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Timestamps, chat bylines, tag text. Minimum size.

styles.name: fine
styles.usage: Long supporting copy on slides and marketing only (the deck's light body). Not in the app.
styles.sample: Rides are matched by flight time and campus.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gap inside tags.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between stacked chips and avatar overlaps.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Inner padding of tags and small pills; list gap between ride cards.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card padding on mobile; screen side margin.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Card padding on desktop and slides; gap between card groups.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Section gap; header bottom padding.

tokens.name: space-7
tokens.usage: Hero and slide margins.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Slide outer margin; empty-state spacing.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Inner chips, number pills inside cards, avatar tiles at 40px.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Inputs as fields in dense forms, photo tiles, small cards.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Glass cards, content cards, ride cards, chat bubbles.

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: Bottom sheets, phone-frame panels, full-width glass slabs.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Buttons, nav, segmented control, tags, text fields. The default shape: when unsure, pill.

tokens.name: shadow-glass
tokens.usage: Resting glass cards and the nav pill.

tokens.name: shadow-lift
tokens.usage: Bottom sheets, the FAB, menus that float over content.

tokens.name: shadow-none
tokens.usage: Flat charcoal slabs; the deck never shadows its dark panels.

blur.note: Backdrop blur for glass. Use as backdrop-filter: blur(value) saturate(140%).

tokens.name: glass-blur
tokens.usage: All glass panels, nav and sheets.

tokens.name: glass-blur-soft
tokens.usage: Small glass pills (tags, number pills) where a strong blur smears text behind.

tokens.name: control-sm
tokens.usage: Compact buttons in cards; never the only way to do something on mobile.

tokens.name: control-md
tokens.usage: Default button, text field and segmented control height (touch-safe).

tokens.name: control-lg
tokens.usage: Primary CTA and the FAB.

tokens.name: avatar-md
tokens.usage: Rider rows and headers.
